newsitem.title: FRANCE: France hopes Russia will help solve Serbia crisis.
newsitem.headline: France hopes Russia will help solve Serbia crisis.

text.p: France said on Monday it hopes Russia can help defuse Serbia's political crisis by persuading Belgrade to recognise opposition election victories in 14 cities.
"There is only one way out of this crisis: recognition of the opposition victories" in the 14 cities, foreign ministry spokesman Yves Doutriaux told reporters.
Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Igor Ivanov was in Belgrade to meet Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic later on Monday in a bid to help break the standoff that has triggered 10 weeks of protests.
"We have been informed of the contacts between the Russian authorities and Belgrade aimed at reaching a satisfactory solution to this crisis," Doutriaux said.
"We hope that these contacts will allow the start of a democratic dialogue" based on recognition of the opposition wins, he said.

Up to 200,000 people marched through Belgrade on Monday in the first daytime march in Belgrade since a ban was imposed following clashes between opposition and pro-government demonstrators on December 24.
